Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. A couple of items we want to lock down before the kickoff:

- SCIM mapping: our HR system exports these attributes: email, firstName, lastName, employeeId, department, title. We need to understand how Redwood maps groups and whether we can sync a secondary attribute (costCenter).
- Service identities: we plan to run Redwood agents from our prod VPC; we need guidance on dedicated service accounts vs ephemeral service identities for automated provisioning.
- IP allowlist / egress: security requires we provide exact outbound IP ranges. Can you confirm what Redwood will need and the suggested CIDR format?

Attaching a sample export and our current allowlist CSV. Also looping in our platform team (it@edgewave.io) for the network details.

Appreciate a quick checklist so we can close pre-kickoff items.

Thanks,
Samir

Date: 2026-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: onboarding next steps - identities + network

Samir — thanks for the detail and the attachments. Quick responses inline and a short pre-kickoff checklist below.

SCIM mapping
- We can map email, firstName, lastName, employeeId, department, title by default.
- costCenter can be mapped as a custom attribute; we’ll need the exact attribute key in your export (column header) — Neha, can you confirm drop-in mapping steps?

Service identities
- For agents running in your VPC we recommend a dedicated service account per environment (prod/staging) with scoped permissions. Ephemeral identities (short-lived tokens) are supported for CI pipelines but add complexity for KV cache continuity.
- We’ll provide a Terraform snippet and a JSON role policy.

IP allowlist / egress
- Redwood will consume a list of CIDRs for two purposes: management/control-plane callbacks (required) and optional model-serving egress (if you route through our hosted endpoints).
- For Dedicated/private deployments we also publish a set of outbound IP ranges for our NAT egress; provide your firewall team the sample CSV and we’ll confirm exact ranges before cutover.

Pre-kickoff checklist (things we need from EdgeWave before the kickoff meeting):
1) Confirm SCIM CSV column names and indicate whether costCenter is present.
2) Approve creation of two service accounts (prod, staging) — we’ll send role suggestions.
3) Provide firewall contact and a primary public-sourced CIDR for your NAT (if you’re restricting egress).
4) Confirm PKI/KMS approach if you want to use customer-managed keys.

Next steps: we’ll follow-up with a short tech doc and Terraform snippets. Proposed kickoff: Tues 2026-07-27 10:00 AM PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick technical items from the implementation team:

1) SCIM: if EdgeWave can export a header row with exact column names we can apply a mapping template. For costCenter we’ll need a stable attribute (not free text) — if you only have free text we recommend a one-time normalization step. I’ve sketched a mapping table (see below).

  - scim:userName -> email
  - name.givenName -> firstName
  - name.familyName -> lastName
  - externalId -> employeeId
  - urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:department -> department
  - urn:custom:costCenter -> costCenter (if provided)

2) Service accounts/roles: we recommend the following minimal IAM scope for the prod service account: read-only to user metadata API + write to tenant-config endpoint (to manage group bindings). We will NOT store secrets in plaintext — recommend integrating with your KMS for long-lived keys.

3) IP ranges: please confirm whether your firewall team accepts CIDR ranges in a single/aggregate list. We will publish our expected outbound list at least 72 hours before any cutover, but for preflight testing provide the sample CSV you attached.

4) Test accounts: please create two test users in your IdP (one admin, one standard) for our staging validation.

I’m attaching the mapping template and a small sample Terraform snippet for the prod service account.

Neha
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: mapping-template.json (example mapping), tf-service-account-prod.tf
